title: Navy gave Pais crash material for his patents

tellings.quote: I'm going to guess they gave him some crash material and he figured out how they write down the equations for it

plain: Bob Maguire, described as a former CIA contractor, talks about Salvatore Pais, a US Navy scientist who filed patents in the 2010s for strange, advanced craft and devices. Maguire guesses that the Navy gave Pais material from a crashed unknown craft, and that Pais worked out the equations behind it and wrote them into his patents. If true, the patents would be a public trace of studying a recovered craft to learn how it works.
